title: Pricing Desk Rule: Grace-Period Renewal Rate on Rolled-Over Small Business Electricity Supply Agreements
content:
**Rule.** The standard grace-period renewal rate for a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement renewed after rollover is the renewal rate stated in the final options notice that announced the expired term's end, rounded half up to the cent per kWh.

## Terms of the rule

- **The final options notice that announced the expired term's end.** The final options notice on the agreement, the latest by notice date where more than one is on record; the contract end date it refers to (its effective date) is the expired contract end date.
- **Starting rate.** The renewal rate that notice states, in cents per kWh.
- **Order.** The starting rate comes first; any amounts in cents per kWh taken off it are then added to it once; the result is rounded half up to the cent per kWh only at the end.

## Hypothetical worked example

A rolled-over agreement whose final options notice, referring to a contract end date of 31 December, stated a renewal rate of 9.20 cents per kWh and a month-to-month rate of 11.90 cents per kWh. The starting rate is 9.20, and the grace-period renewal rate, rounded half up to the cent per kWh at the end, is 9.20 cents per kWh. The month-to-month rate stated on the notice is not the renewal rate.
